length_limits.notes: No length limit: submissions must be topical, refereeable scientific contributions following accepted standards of scholarly communication.

figure_spec.notes: PostScript and EPS need LaTeX processing; JPEG, GIF, PNG and PDF need pdfLaTeX. Formats may not be mixed within one submission, and figures must be embedded rather than linked.

reference_style.style: None: arXiv has no house citation style and leaves it to the author or the target journal.

submission_steps: upload the files individually or as a zip or tar.gz through arXiv's own submission system
select the compiler and the top-level TeX file, which must carry a \documentclass directive
review the auto-detected file issues and preview the compiled PDF
fill the metadata page, then submit
submissions received by 14:00 US Eastern are generally public around 20:00 the same day
every submission is moderated for topicality; a new user or a new category may need an endorsement

template.notes: No template is linked from the submission help page.

license_of_summary_source.statement: Authors choose CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, arXiv's own perpetual non-exclusive licence 1.0, or CC0, and grant arXiv an irrevocable distribution licence either way; article metadata is separately CC0 1.0.
